title: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property

abstractEnglish: We prove the cotype–cotype conjecture under the ordinary approximation property. A nonzero real Banach space with this property is K-convex if and only if both the space and its dual have finite Rademacher cotype, possibly with different exponents.
